summary: Fixed cost of using the vehicle at all (added once if the vehicle is used).
businessRules: Discourages using an extra vehicle unless it reduces total cost enough.
fixed defines: Specify a fixed cost for using a vehicle. It should be a positive integer. Default value is 0.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.costs. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: high fixed cost -> solver consolidates onto fewer vehicles.
